params.docTitle: Standard operating procedure for the segregation of duties in treasury and payments

blocks.text: Segregation of duties for treasury operations and payment approvals

No individual may initiate, approve and reconcile the same payment. Where the team is too small to separate these duties, a compensating control must be documented, approved by the regional controller and reviewed every quarter by internal audit.
Approval thresholds and escalation to the second line of defence

Payments above the regional threshold require two approvers from different reporting lines, and payments to new counterparties require an additional verification call to a number already held on file.
Exceptions are recorded in the register with their owner, their reason and their expiry date.
